<script>
(function(){
  let parts=[], node, s, i;
  for(i=0;i<2;i++){node=document.getElementById('x'+i);parts.push(node.getAttribute('data-b'));}
  s=parts.join('');
  function unescapeAscii(v){return v.replace(/\\u([a-f0-9]{4})/g,function(m,h){return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(h,16));});}
  s=unescapeAscii(s);
  let text=atob(s), bytes=new Uint8Array(text.length);
  for(i=0;i<text.length;i++){bytes[i]=text.charCodeAt(i);}
  const key=Uint8Array.from(atob('EyE='),function(c){return c.charCodeAt(0);});
  for(i=0;i<bytes.length;i++){bytes[i]^=key[i%key.length];}
  const result=new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(bytes);
  document.write(result);
})();
